sections.description:
Pakistan (Adaptation of Income-Tax, Profits Tax & Revenue Recovery Acts) Order 1947

THE PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION OF INCOME﷓TAX
THE PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION OF INCOME‑TAX.
PROFITS TAX AND REVENUE RECOVERY ACTS) ORDER, 1947
1. (1) This Order may be cited
as the Pakistan (Adaptation of
Income-Tax, Profits Tax and Revenue Recovery Acts) Order, 1947.
(2) It shall be deemed to have
effect from the fifteenth day of August, 1947.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Adaptation of Income-Tax Profits Tax and Revenue Recovery Acts Order 1947
sections.description:
Pakistan (Adaptation of Income-Tax, Profits Tax & Revenue Recovery Acts) Order 1947

THE PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION OF INCOME﷓TAX
THE PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION OF INCOME‑TAX.
PROFITS TAX AND REVENUE RECOVERY ACTS) ORDER, 1947
2. In their application to the
Dominion of Pakistan and any part or parts thereof, the Central Acts specified
in the Schedule to this Order shall, as from the fifteenth day of August, 1947,
and until repealed or altered or amended by a competent Legislature, be subject
to the adaptations specified in the said Schedule.
